editorial.title: Editorial independence
points: Potential.org and its qualified reviewer write and check every lesson, journey and calculator default.
Sponsors do not see, edit or approve content before it is published.
Fees and rules are sourced and dated from public sources, never from a sponsor.

labelling.title: Labelling
points: Every sponsored slot carries the "Sponsored" label at its top corner, in English and Arabic.
The label names the partner and cannot be hidden, shortened or restyled.
Sponsored offers sit only in the labelled Offers area, calculator slot, track badge and events.

influence.title: No influence on content or rankings
points: Sponsors cannot change calculator results, journey scores, Dalil's answers or the order of anything shown.
Dalil, the AI guide, never recommends a sponsor's product or a specific property.
Potential.org can pause any placement at any time; paused placements disappear from every screen.

data.title: Personal data
points: A learner's name, email and phone go to a partner only after a separate, unticked-by-default consent for that single request.
Learners can withdraw consent in their profile at any time.
